hover:nav_link.reason: The nav triggers are <button> elements whose mega-menu opens through CSS :hover / group-hover on an ancestor; a dispatched MouseEvent sets no :hover state, and a trusted CDP mouse move over the trigger changed nothing in the snapshot scope (measured: link color stayed rgb(14,14,14)). Inconclusive on live, not proof of absence. The panel markup is pre-mounted in the captured DOM (the mega-menu panels ship in dom.html and are toggled by class), so the reveal exists in the clone but is not machine-measurable with this probe — confirm it in the review round by hovering 'Products' / 'Resources' / 'Docs'.

hover:tab_requirements.reason: Tab strip in 'How full service works'. Hover only shifts the text colour (transition-colors duration-200 on the button; the selected tab is already text-white), and the synthetic probe observed nothing on live. The clone keeps the same markup, classes and transition; the selected tab's white text and the 2px fc-progress bar under it match the captured frame (visual gate: 0 fails). Confirm by hovering the inactive tabs in the review round.

hover:tab_how.reason: Same tab strip as hover:tab_requirements — inactive tab hover is a colour transition only, invisible to the synthetic probe on live. Markup, classes and the transition are captured verbatim in the clone; verify the colour change by hovering the inactive tabs in the review round.

reveal:span.fc-reel.reason: This is a continuously rolling odometer digit, not a one-shot reveal. Three consecutive 1s samples of the same element on live read translateY -604.96px, -719.04px, then -360px (its resting offset) — an interval rotation. Per docs/WORKFLOW.md's observed-mutation rule the end state of a continuously mutating element can never agree between two independent captures, so the reported -1002.96px vs -576px are two frames of the same loop, not a fidelity gap. The clone carries the captured resting frame and the visual gate matches it (0 fails across 9922 comparisons); the roll itself is a motion-pass phenomenon, and sibling digit strips (span:nth-of-type(7..13)) are covered by sampled motion items.

declared:products-menu.reason: Mega-menu panel for 'Products'. The panel is pre-mounted in the captured DOM and opens on hover/focus (CSS group-hover + visibility), so the scroll sweep and synthetic hover cannot fire it — the marker is a transition-from-start-state on a panel that only shows under a pointer. Panel markup, links and styling are in the clone verbatim; confirm the open/close behaviour in the review round.

declared:resources-menu.reason: Mega-menu panel for 'Resources' — same pre-mounted, hover/focus-opened panel as products-menu. Not reachable by the synthetic probe; markup and styling are captured verbatim in the clone. Confirm in the review round.

declared:docs-menu.reason: Mega-menu panel for 'Docs' — same pre-mounted, hover/focus-opened panel as products-menu. Not reachable by the synthetic probe; markup and styling are captured verbatim in the clone. Confirm in the review round.

declared:span.absolute.h-[1.5px].reason: The two 1.5px bars of the mobile hamburger button (header, lg:hidden).
